items.a: An export receivable: the amount an overseas buyer owes an Indian exporter under a shipped invoice. You buy it outright, inside your programme limit, without recourse for the buyer’s credit.

items.q: Who carries the buyer’s credit, and who carries disputes?
items.a: You carry the buyer’s credit, insured in your name. The exporter carries disputes, returns, set-off and fraud, and answers for its own warranties.

items.q: Is the cover in my name?
items.a: Yes. In a programme the credit-insurance policy is in your name, on buyer limits the insurer approves. Until that policy is signed, a programme can start on exporters’ own policies with claims assigned to you; we say which applies before you buy anything.
You do. The buyer pays your collection account, and you pay the exporter’s account at its own bank. Kubar never holds an account, receives a payment or releases funds.

items.q: How do I know the shipment and the invoice are real?
items.a: Each element of the evidence package comes from a system the exporter doesn’t control: Indian Customs for the shipping bill, the carrier for the bill of lading, the insurer for the limit, the buyer for its acknowledgement and the exporter’s bank for its no-objection. Kubar checks them against each other before anything is offered to you.

items.q: Who is Kubar, and under what mandate does it act?
items.a: Kubar Labs is the brand of Kubar Protocol Private Limited, founded in India in 2024. Under a written mandate from you, Kubar designs the pool and its rules, checks and documents each receivable, services it and reports. The purchase runs on your licence and your credit policies; Kubar never makes the credit decision, holds money or carries credit risk. Kubar’s own ITFS registration is targeted for 2027; until then Kubar acts as the financier’s origination and servicing agent.

items.q: What happens if a buyer doesn’t pay?
items.a: Kubar flags the late payment, checks with the exporter for any dispute and sends the notices your policy requires. As the insured, you lodge the claim under your policy, with the evidence package behind it. The exporter answers only for its own side of the trade: disputes, returns, set-off, fraud and its warranties.

Programme terms on your own paper (the rules, your limit, the caps and the reporting); a mandate appointing Kubar as your origination and servicing agent; the credit-insurance policy, between you and the insurer; and a receivables purchase agreement with each exporter in the programme.
By a fee from you and a fee from the exporter, for running the programme. Kubar earns nothing from holding money or credit risk.

gift.heading: Why GIFT City.
gift.lead: GIFT City is India’s international financial services centre. Banks’ units there work in foreign currency and can buy export receivables under their own licences and credit policies, which is how Programme 1 runs. It is also home to the framework for trade-finance platforms (ITFS) under which Kubar’s own venue is planned<marker></marker>. Kubar works from an office in GIFT City.

meta.title: Privacy notice · Kubar Labs
meta.description: How Kubar Labs handles personal data collected through kubar.tech.

sections.title: Who we are
blocks: Kubar Labs is the brand of Kubar Protocol Private Limited, a company incorporated in India (CIN U70200WB2024PTC274850), with its registered office at Paras Market, Station Road, Barakar, West Bengal 713324 (“Kubar”, “we”). This notice explains how we handle personal data collected through kubar.tech. We decide why and how this data is used.

sections.title: What we collect
blocks: – What you send through the contact form: your name, work email, organisation, role (if you give it), who you’re writing as and your message.
– What you send us by email.

– Technical data that our hosting provider handles to deliver and protect the site, such as your IP address, browser type and the pages you request. We use your IP address briefly to limit repeated form submissions, and we don’t store it with your message.
– Aggregate figures on how the site is used, from Cloudflare Web Analytics, which uses no cookies or local storage and doesn’t fingerprint visitors.
We don’t ask for sensitive personal data, such as passwords or financial, health or biometric information. Please don’t send it.

sections.title: Cookies
blocks: The site sets no cookies for analytics or advertising. Our hosting provider may set a strictly necessary cookie to protect the site from automated traffic.

sections.title: Why we use it
blocks: – To reply to your enquiry and to continue the conversation you start.
– To keep the site and the form secure and working.
– To understand, in aggregate, how the site is used.
We don’t sell personal data, and we don’t use it for advertising.

sections.title: Who we share it with
blocks: – Kubar staff who need it to reply to you.
– Service providers that process it for us: Cloudflare (hosting, security, form delivery and analytics) and Google (email). These providers may process data outside India.
– Authorities, where the law requires it.

sections.title: How long we keep it
blocks: We keep enquiries for [24 months] after our last exchange, unless a business relationship follows or the law requires us to keep them longer.

sections.title: How we protect it
blocks: We follow reasonable security practices: access only for staff who need it, encrypted connections, and providers that follow recognised security standards.

sections.title: Your rights
blocks: You can ask us to tell you what personal data we hold about you, to correct or update it, to delete it where we don’t need to keep it, and to stop using it by withdrawing your consent. You can nominate someone to act for you, and you can raise a grievance with our Grievance Officer. From 13 May 2027, when the remaining provisions of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and its Rules apply, you may also complain to the Data Protection Board of India if we haven’t resolved your grievance.

sections.title: Grievance Officer
blocks: Keshav Dudani, Grievance Officer, Kubar Protocol Private Limited, Paras Market, Station Road, Barakar, West Bengal 713324; keshav@kubar.tech. We reply within one month of receiving a grievance.

sections.title: Children
blocks: The site is for businesses and institutions, not for children, and we don’t knowingly collect children’s personal data.

sections.title: Changes
blocks: We post any change here, with the date it takes effect.
